title: Poems in Periodicities
pieces: Tomorrow, the Things We Want, but in Having Reject Out of Fear
notes: From Dusie packet (same acceptance). Notes say Periodicities in Feb — use research.pubDate. Distinct from Tuesday Poem. Cover = article screenshot (og:image was unrelated profile photo). IG blocked.

research.excerpt: Kid Cumulus forgets his name / and goes hunting for it / in the forest of proper nouns, / cutting his own trail, / cutting his friends in half / to peer through the telescope / of their intestines / to climb the rungs of their sex / into the dripping moon.
